title: Prove nine-channel delivery floor for monotone tariffs
body:
## Result and scope

For the fixed PR #5745 source and immutable one-frame payload contract, at most nine channels cost at least 8 H8 for any positive nondecreasing tariff, including arbitrary temporal reuse and jointly canceled nuisance. The exact two-frame certificate covers 879 frames and 385,881 frame pairs. This does not establish a new multiplication exponent or cover changed source words, payloads, or moving frames.

## Task and overlap

Base: de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a; predecessor #5745: e82b64e91e57c838ff2028bcf2219203966bf9ed. PR #5823 separately proposes an any-finite-channel result for concave power tariffs; its full certificate was not replayed here. This submission covers at most nine channels under the broader monotone tariff assumption.

## Validation

A separate all-event adjoint census and orthogonal projector reproduce the response spaces and pair result. Normal certificate generation and optimized verification passed with CPython 3.14.4. Reproduce: `python3 -B research/nine-channel-monotone-bound/verify.py` and `python3 -O -B research/nine-channel-monotone-bound/verify.py`. The proof and finite certificate remain without independent human or proof-kernel review.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman, flyingviper, and the retained predecessor authors as detailed in PROOF.md. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next questions

For arbitrary monotone tariffs, examine three-frame sums for ten or more channels, then check complete payload and cost. See README for scope and blockers.
